$description: What is enforced vs. convention for token usage.

rawValueRestrictions.color: Reference semantic roles (text.*, surface.*, border.*, focus.*) or foundation color paths; raw hex only inside color.mock-only demo chrome.
rawValueRestrictions.font: Use font.family.* via semantic font.heading/body/mock-code; sizes from font.size / font.sizeCustom only.
rawValueRestrictions.radius: radius.* scale only (v4 scale); radius.floating-card and radius.icon-tile are component-scoped.
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: N x spacing.unit (N in 0..200 step .5); section rhythm via layout.section-y / band-y.
rawValueRestrictions.shadow: shadow.* via elevation.* roles; never ad-hoc box-shadows.
rawValueRestrictions.easing: easing.* tokens only; motion values must come from the motion pattern registry.
rawValueRestrictions.duration: duration.* tokens or a registry pattern's durationMs.

machineChecked: token-catalog namespaces == real token file keys (verify_all TOKEN_CATALOG_KEYS)
rawValueRestrictions keys are real catalog namespaces (verify_all TOKEN_CATALOG_KEYS)
semantic references resolve to foundation tokens and themes/light.json equals the recomputed resolution (verify_all TOKEN_REFERENCES)
motion values in a PageSpec equal the registry (semantic_validate MOTION_VALUES_PINNED)
convention: Implementation code follows rules/tailwind-v3-v4.json; nothing in this repo lints JSX/CSS.

overrides: PageSpecs carry NO per-instance style/token override field: styling is owned by section/component contracts, so there is nothing token-related to validate or mutate at the PageSpec layer (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21). Token drift is guarded at the catalog/policy layer instead.
